rationale.intuition:
Regression lock for PR #292 / #293 PROGRAM_NOT_OFFERED verification: Hofstra University does not offer Early Decision. The school runs two non-binding Early Action rounds (EA I 11/15, EA II 12/15) plus rolling admission — verified in Hofstra's own admissions deadlines page and own CDS Section C21. Pre-fix engine behavior at Hofstra (overall 68.08%, yieldRate=10.3%, no edAcceptanceRate): yield-informed ED fallback fires with a low yield → ~3.2× multiplier, taking the prediction to the 2.5× anchor clamp (~98%) for an applicant who literally cannot submit an ED application here.

Fixture asserts ED ≈ RD (delta within ±5pp). Failure means either (a) the data layer fix (hasEarlyDecision=false backfill for Hofstra) never landed and the seed still leaves the field null, or (b) the engine reintroduced an unconditional ED boost path that ignores hasEarlyDecision=false.
